_comment: Real Microsoft Graph API schema for /identity/conditionalAccess/policies — this is the exact JSON shape the Graph API expects, deployable via Microsoft Graph PowerShell or REST, not a Bicep resource (Entra ID Conditional Access is a Graph object, not an ARM/Azure resource — that distinction matters and is documented, not glossed over).
displayName: CA001 - Require MFA for All Users
_deployment_note: state is set to 'enabledForReportingButNotEnforced' deliberately — the real-world rollout pattern is report-only first, review sign-in logs for unexpected breakage, then flip to 'enabled'. Shipping straight to 'enabled' without a report-only period is how CA policies lock organizations out of their own tenant.
